Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle activities. Configure and maintain high availability technologies including Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering. Implement database security through access controls, encryption, auditing, and STIG compliance. Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, replication, and integrity issues. Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and T-SQL to improve operational efficiency. Collaborate with developers on database design, schema changes, stored procedures, and application performance optimization. Create custom reports based on customer requirements. Configure and maintain document libraries, lists, workflows, and enterprise collaboration features. Perform SharePoint backup, restoration, disaster recovery testing, and system maintenance. Monitor system availability and participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and change management activities. Gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and implementation plans. Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and architecture diagrams.
